title: Signal
description: Decision-relevant consequence of a state diff (or clock tick). A candidate for trigger evaluation, never an action by itself.

subject_claim_id.description: The claim behind the state item this signal reports (a blocker, commitment or field). Openness follows that item (matched by item key), so a newer claim that rewords it does not close the signal; only a status change does (ADR-0011).

occurred_at.description: When the reported change happened in the world: the latest evidence occurred_at, or the clock tick's observed_at. created_at is when we recorded it. Event windows and 'open as of T' queries run on occurred_at (ADR-0015).

expires_at.description: End of the EVENT window: occurred_at + eventWindowDays. null for STANDING signals, which stay open while their standingOpenWhile condition holds (ADR-0011, ADR-0015).

dedupe_key.description: Idempotency key: the same fact evaluated again (a retried recompute, a repeated clock tick) never persists a second signal. Unique per account.

rule.description: Rule id that emitted the signal, e.g. 'sig.new_stakeholder@1'.

allOf.description: EVENT signals carry occurred_at and the end of their window; STANDING signals have no window (ADR-0015).
A contradiction names the field and both claims, with evidence, so the rep can confirm (ADR-0008).

eventWindowDays.description: EVENT signals are open for this many days after occurred_at (ADR-0011, ADR-0015). No state field bounds them reliably: buying-group status 'new' ends when the stakeholder first writes, which is exactly when knowledge such as K17 is needed.

eventSignalType.description: EVENT signals report something that happened; for knowledge matching they are open for eventWindowDays after occurred_at.

standingSignalType.description: STANDING signals report a condition; they are open while the condition in standingOpenWhile still holds in the current AccountState.

standingOpenWhile.description: Per STANDING signal type: the AccountState condition that keeps it open.

security_blocker_appeared.description: the blockers item the signal reported (subject_claim_id, matched by its item key, not by which claim currently wins) has status open or overdue

commitment_overdue.description: the current_commitments item the signal reported (subject_claim_id, matched by item key) has status overdue

stakeholder_gap.description: coverage_gaps still lists the gap named in details.gap

customer_went_silent.description: no customer activity after the signal (last_customer_interaction <= occurred_at)

field_contradicted.description: the field's conflicts still list the contradicting claim (until a human confirms, ADR-0008)
